label: The five-point stencil
subgoals: Replace the Laplacian by the five-point difference
Set the interior node to the average of its four neighbours
Hold conductor nodes at their fixed potentials

label: Iterating to convergence
subgoals: Choose Jacobi or Gauss-Seidel update order
Average each node's neighbours using old or new values
Repeat sweeps until the change falls below tolerance

label: From potential to capacitance
subgoals: Draw a closed contour around the conductor through the grid
Sum the potential drops across the crossed cell edges
Multiply by epsilon and divide by the voltage
